doc.name: Pulltrader Seller Economics
doc.description: Read-only, deterministic seller-economics calculators for trading cards. Compare estimated proceeds, calculate a sale price for a target payout, and explain selling methods. Send structured JSON skill arguments; no natural-language interpretation, account access, or price changes.

skills.name: Compare seller proceeds
skills.description: Compare fees and estimated net proceeds for a sale across supported marketplaces and Pulltrader selling methods.

skills.name: Calculate required sale price
skills.description: Calculate a per-item sale price needed to reach a target payout or profit after estimated selling fees.

skills.name: Explain selling methods
skills.description: Explain supported selling methods, fulfillment responsibilities, fee components, and estimate limitations.
